model: Claude Opus 5.5 · max effort · Claude Code

parsed.public_message: Orange is NEUTRAL toward all three, as agreed: no first strike through t=300, one full turn of public notice before any change. Main army stays on Little Hill. One passive Orange scout rider will look over the open centre; it won't enter anyone's start region or attack. As Blue said: whoever breaks the truce faces the other three.

private_messages.GPT: Orange is neutral toward you as agreed, and the buffer deal stands. Heads-up so nothing looks hostile: one passive Orange scout rider goes to about (660,600) this turn to look over the open centre. It will not approach your camp or attack. Happy to pass you what it sees of Blue and White each turn if you share what you see. Still open to keeping our neutrality to t=450, then turn by turn with one turn of notice.
private_messages.Gemini: Neutral set, boundary confirmed: you stay west of x=480 and I hold Little Hill; while the truce holds my units also stay east of x=480. Noted the draft math. My scout is looking over the centre lowland (passive, no attacks); I'll pass on anything useful I see of Green or White. Let's compare notes again well before t=300.
private_messages.Grok: Pale Fire holds: Orange is neutral toward you, no attacks through t=300, one full public turn of notice before any change, and I will not enter Central Heights while it holds. The lone Orange rider you may see in the centre lowland is a passive scout.

parsed.notes_to_self: T1(t0): all neutral. Pacts: no 1st strike to t300, 1 public turn notice before change. GPT: respects 150m buffer round (600,440), stays E of centre; offered neutral to t450 then turn-by-turn + sighting swap. Gemini: stays W of x480; I promised to stay E of x480 while truce holds. Grok (Pale Fire): won't enter Little Hill; I won't enter Central Heights. Hannibal aura +20% dmg own+ALLIED soldiers ~50m: stay NEUTRAL, never ally. Elephant leads; spears x2.5 vs cav; swords anti-elephant. Ring ->420@300 (3.2m/s from t150), ->220@450 (1.33m/s), ->90@600 (0.87m/s). Outside=4%/s, dead in 25s! Hill (600,440) safe to ~t468, N edge (620,490) to ~t529. Final circle lowland (640,640): descend ~t500-525 to ~(630,570). T2: scout W to ~(500,640) for Blue, then N for White.
parsed.explanation: Claude honours the pre-battle truce: neutral toward all three rivals, with the army parked on Little Hill, which stays inside the ring until about t=470 and overlooks the final circle. A single passive scout rides to the open centre to locate GPT's army, and the move is announced in advance so nobody mistakes it for an attack.
